extracted.subtask_description: Clarifies where the MPEP addresses unity of invention for PCT applications and which MPEP chapter examiners and applicants should consult for PCT-related unity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Chapter 800 scope regarding PCT unity
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP Chapter 800 does not directly address unity of invention for PCT applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states that Chapter 800 does not cover unity of invention for PCT applications and therefore is not the appropriate MPEP chapter to consult for PCT unity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention for PCT applications — consult MPEP Chapter 1800
rubrics_metrics.description: “The discussion of unity of invention under the Patent Cooperation Treaty Articles and Rules as it is applied as an International Searching Authority, International Preliminary Examining Authority, and in applications entering the National Stage under 35 U.S.C. 371 as a Designated or Elected Office in the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office is covered in MPEP Chapter 1800.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For PCT-related unity of invention issues (as applied by ISA, IPEA, and in national stage entries under 35 U.S.C. 371), examiners and applicants should refer to MPEP Chapter 1800 rather than Chapter 800.
